correctness.rationale: PASS. Graph G_n=K_(n,n) with the alternating Hamiltonian 2-factor a_i b_i and a_i b_(i+1) deleted has faces of Ind_2 precisely vertex sets of induced degree<=1. The proof partitions by selected B subset: zero, one, two adjacent/nonadjacent, three and >=4 fibers under sequential toggles in A. For nonconsecutive B pairs there is one four-vertex critical mixed face each, count n(n-3)/2; subsequent B stages pair all remaining pure independent triples and leave (n^2-3n-2)/2 pure critical four-faces and lone a_0. Thus one critical 0-cell and n^2-3n-1 critical 3-cells. The inspected Deshpande–Singh Proposition 2.10 supplies sequential-matching acyclicity, and Forman gives integral wedge of exactly that many S3 (not merely homology). INDEPENDENT Python construction of all graph faces, sequential matching, directed Hasse acyclicity and exact critical sets for n=4..10 corroborated counts 3,9,17,27,39,53,69; infinite n follows from enumerated fiber cases and cited general matching proposition. At n=3 G3 is a matching so Ind2 is a simplex.
